name: Victor42
summary: Victor42's Chinese-language Hugo blog. It stays at Level 2: when it opens it loads Google Tag Manager (gtag.js) twice from googletagmanager.com, third-party analytics code the visitor has not asked for. It also loads Lato from Google Fonts.
